platformStatus.authMethod: Verified mapped native accounts; anonymous public and opt-in read-only snapshots
platformStatus.notes: Materialized 3014 verified positive A16Z Speedrun 006 Instagram posts. 21 verified Instagram accounts are mapped and 230 candidates remain in explicit review. The logged-in merge accepted 790 exact roster/account/native-author rows and rejected 59; physical post identities are deduplicated before scoring.

platformStatus.authMethod: Verified mapped accounts; public unauthenticated and opt-in read-only evidence
platformStatus.notes: Materialized 235 verified A16Z Speedrun 006 LinkedIn post rows against 182 verified mapped accounts; 575 candidates remain in explicit review. No personal LinkedIn login, cookies, browser session, or interactive account activity is used.

platformStatus.authMethod: Public YouTube pages and metadata against verified mapped channels

platformStatus.authMethod: Public Product Hunt product and launch pages
platformStatus.notes: Materialized 8 verified Product Hunt rows against 3 verified mapped products; 20 candidates remain in explicit review. Public-page availability is not treated as proof of exhaustive launch history.

platformStatus.authMethod: Unauthenticated public Reddit pages or JSON where accessible
platformStatus.notes: Materialized 10 verified A16Z Speedrun 006 Reddit rows; 1 candidates remain in explicit review. Network or access blocks remain target-level blockers rather than fabricated no-post results.

platformStatus.authMethod: Public Hacker News Algolia API with conservative identity matching
platformStatus.notes: The 2026-08-03 hash-chained historical run exhausted configured public pagination for 59/59 A16Z Speedrun 006 companies before the 2026-05-05 recency cutoff. It accepted 1 native historical row for Panorama and verified zero historical native rows for the other 58 targets. The graph currently materializes 2 verified native HN rows, so any difference remains an explicit publication gap. This proves bounded historical source exhaustion, not recent-window completion, and no zero-result target is represented as a post.
